definitions.gloss: going to bed early, early bedtime
definitions.explanation: The practice of going to sleep early in the evening. Often paired with {早起|はやお}き (early rising) as a healthy habit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早寝|はやね}⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's go to bed early today.

examples.japanese: {早寝|はやね}⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Going to bed early and rising early is good for your health.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早寝|はやね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: I had a habit of going to bed early as a child, but since becoming an adult, I've been staying up late more often.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set phrase {早寝|はやね}⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧ (early to bed, early to rise). Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {早寝|はやね}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go to bed early). The proverb {早寝|はやね}⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦{病|やまい}→病：13610_yamai⟧⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず means "early to bed and early to rise keeps you healthy."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早寝|はやね}⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧: early to bed, early to rise
- {早寝|はやね}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go to bed early
- {早寝|はやね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧: habit of going to bed early

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧: staying up late (opposite habit)
